steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each line's volume is matched to its capacity. A volume above capacity needs an action.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Planned volume above capacity with no action
findings.fix: Add a shift or move volume to another line

findings.title: Headcount with no basis
findings.fix: Give the basis for the headcount

findings.title: Line with no volume source
findings.fix: Name the source of the volume

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] plan-line-2.md:12  Planned volume above capacity with no action.
       Fix: Add a shift or move volume to another line.
[medium] plan-headcount.md:19  Headcount with no basis.
       Fix: Give the basis for the headcount.
[low] plan-volume.csv:26  Line with no volume source.
       Fix: Name the source of the volume.
Not checked: Demand not in the plan.
pros: Checks a planned volume above capacity with no action, a headcount with no basis, and a line with no volume source.
cons: Not checked: Demand not in the plan.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mfg-annual-production-plan skill on the records for this review.
